text: New facility in Osaka could cost $6.3bn to construct, with partial opening by 2028 Anthropic's first dedicated data center in Japan is expected to be built by NTT Data Group and would have one of the largest processing capacities in the country. (Source photos by Reuters and Hikaru Yagi) TOKYO/OSAKA -- NTT Data Group is in the final stages of talks to build a data center in western Japan for U.S. AI company Anthropic, multiple sources have told Nikkei.
